title: Bank Deposit Error Resolution under the Remittance Transfer Rule
content:
Under the Remittance Transfer Rule the customer may give notice of an error on a Bank Deposit transfer. Three kinds of error may be asserted:

| Kind of error | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Not received by the date | the money was not available to the recipient by the date of availability |
| Incorrect amount | the recipient received less than the disclosed amount received, other than an SHA intermediary deduction within the disclosed estimate |
| Wrong account details | the money was deposited to an account other than the one in the transfer's beneficiary details |

## Notice

1. The notice is the customer's own assertion and the customer gives it; the agent explains the process.
2. A notice can be given only within the tier's error-notice period of calendar days after the disclosed date of availability. The period is counted in calendar days from the date of availability, and a notice on the date of availability plus the period is on time.
3. Only one notice of each kind may be open on a transfer at a time.
4. The resolution due date is the notice date plus the tier's decision period in calendar days.

*Hypothetical boundary:* with a date of availability on day A and a 180-day period, a notice on A plus 180 is on time; a notice on A plus 181 is not.

## Decision

5. Paloma's error-resolution team decides: no error when the cause lies with the customer (beneficiary details the customer supplied were wrong, or a hold lasted because the customer answered a request for information late), error found otherwise.
6. On a finding of error found, every fee collected on the transfer is refunded with the refund reason "Paloma error", unless it was already refunded under the on-time promise.
7. A remedy can be chosen only after a decision of error found on that notice.

## Remedies in force

8. For wrong account details, and for not received by the date while the money has still not been deposited, the customer chooses between a refund of the principal and delivery to the correct account at no cost. Paloma funds whichever is chosen when the original payout cannot be recovered, as a make-good credit for an error refund or for an error redelivery.
9. The choice is the customer's own. A refund is issued within the tier's refund time, and a delivery within the tier's redelivery time in Paloma business days, of the choice.
10. On a finding of no error nothing is owed and the customer is told the finding; for wrong details a recall is the remaining route.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following two clauses of this policy are **no longer in force**; each is superseded by the current basis for incorrect-amount errors and is kept here only as retired text:

> ~~For an incorrect amount, Paloma credits the shortfall as a make-good credit for an incorrect-amount shortfall.~~ (no longer in force)

> ~~For an incorrect amount, the customer chooses to have the shortfall delivered or refunded, a shortfall refund being booked on the error-shortfall basis.~~ (no longer in force)

Every other clause above remains in force.

superseded_clauses: For incorrect_amount, Paloma credits the shortfall (bank_paloma_credit, credit_reason incorrect_amount_shortfall)
the customer chooses to have the shortfall delivered (resend_shortfall) or refunded (refund_shortfall, booked with refund_basis error_shortfall)
